name: debian-diagnostic
description: Inspect Debian processes and systemd, read actual logs, verify conversation active
when: Inspect Debian processes and systemd, read actual logs, verify conversation active
prerequisites: Owner policy grants referenced resources; confirm with host_policy
Dedicated mission workspace; no existing services changed

arguments.command: ps -eo comm= | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head -12

on_error: Stop on failure; inspect receipt and correct only the observed cause, then retest or resume run_id with identical parameters.
changelog: v1 bootstrap Codex mission25; JARVIS must test and activate
